name: third-batch
about: Women artists, about 20 works. Cleveland ids first (they publish a description to quote), then Met ids (no description: each needs a hook) and Commons searches (a file page has no museum sentence: each needs a hook). Mary Cassatt is not in the Met's open access set, and Cleveland holds only five women painters, so this batch is smaller in Cleveland than the others. Nothing reaches the game until a person approves a draft.
